Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund – medical help scheme launched on April 1999 under Chief Minister’s Relief Fund in Rajasthan. Dependents of untimely dead due to famine, floods, excessive rains, fires and accidental accidents help.

detailed_description: "Chikitsa Pratipoorti Yojana" is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training & Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. benefits:

The scheme's benefits are applicable once per disease per beneficiary.
NOTE:
 The benefits under the scheme will be payable after the recommendation of the district-level committee.

Application:
Step 1:
 Visit the 
Official website

name: Chief Minister’s Health Insurance Scheme - Nagaland
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Health & Wellness
tags: Health Coverage, Health Insurance, Nagaland Government Health Insurance, Affordable Health Insurance, Cashless Health Insurance, Nagaland
brief_description: Launched on 16th October 2022, the scheme "Chief Minister Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS)" is a Public Health Insurance Scheme by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Nagaland. This scheme provides cashless treatment up to ₹20 lakhs for employees and pensioners and ₹5 lakhs.
detailed_description:
Launched on 16th October 2022, the scheme &quot;Chief Minister Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS)&quot; is a Public Health Insurance Scheme by the Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Nagaland. This scheme provides cashless treatment up to ₹20 lakhs for employees and pensioners and ₹5 lakhs for the general category, covering inpatient and specific daycare procedures in empanelled hospitals across India.
The applications are accepted through Primary Health Centres (PHCs), Community Health Centres (CHCs), District and Sub-division Treasury Offices, outreach camps, and designated private hospitals.
The scheme is being implemented by the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Nagaland.
benefits:
All beneficiaries of the scheme are entitled to free and cashless hospitalization care for various ailments including pre-existing conditions/diseases, which can be availed from any empanelled hospital across the country. The treatment will include both surgical and medical procedures and limited day-care packages. However, OPD services and standalone diagnostics investigations will not be covered.

   1. CMHIS (GEN) beneficiaries will be entitled to more than 1950 medical and surgical packages across 27 major clinical specialties as well as entitlement to General Ward, similar to AB PM-JAY.
   1. CMHIS (EP) beneficiaries will be entitled similar to that available for central government employees under the Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) as well as differential room entitlement as per their employee grade.

<br>

**Annual Risk Cover/ Sum Insured per family:**

   1. For CMHIS (GEN) beneficiary families, the Sum Insured is ₹ 5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lakhs Only) per family per annum on a family floater basis, similar to AB PM-JAY.
   1. For CMHIS (EP) beneficiary families, the Sum Insured is ₹ 20,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty Lakhs Only) per family per annum on a family floater basis.
   1. Further, for Government employees, any additional expenses beyond the sum insured shall be reimbursed on a case-to-case basis by the State government on recommendation of the State Medical Board.

name: Delhi Arogya Kosh
tags: Arogya Kosh, Delhi, Financial Assistance, Family Health
brief_description: "Delhi Arogya Kosh” (DAK) provides Financial assistance to needy eligible patients for treatment of any illness/treatment/intervention required by the patient undergoing treatment in a Government Hospital run by Delhi Government or Central Government or Autonomous Hospital under the State Government
detailed_description:
**Details**
The Governing Body of Delhi Arogya Kosh in its 13th meeting held on 28.02.2017 resolved that financial assistance shall be provided for Ultrasound, Doppler Studies, Mammography, EEG, EMG, TMT &amp; ECHO from both non-NABH &amp; NABH ACCREDITED DGEHS EMPANELLED STANDALONE DIAGNOSTIC centres to any eligible patient who is a bonafide resident of Delhi, identified on the basis of Voter ID card; Aadhaar Card; Passport; Driving License; Ration Card; Extract from the electoral roll and Birth Certificate along with identity proof of either parent (for children below five years of age), undergoing treatment in any of the 25 Hospitals owned by Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (GNCTD) or in any of the 23 polyclinics attached to these hospitals or in any of the 05 hospitals run under autonomous mode by GNCTD
benefits:
Benefits
Provides financial assistance of Rs. 5 lacs to needy eligible patients for treatment of any illness /disease in a Government hospital run by Delhi  Government or  Central Government or Local Bodies or  Autonomous Hospitals under State Government
documents_required:
Requisite documents for verification of INCOME (any one of the following):
National Food Security Card for income less than Rs. 1 lakh per annum.
Income Certificate issued from area SDM (or any other officer authorized on this behalf by the Revenue Department) for income up to Rs. 3 lakhs per annum. 
Requisite document for verification of DOMICILE for the last 03 years (any one of the following):
Domicile Certificate issued from area SDM.
Ration card.
EPIC (Voter ID).
Driving License.
Passport.
Extract from the Electoral Roll.
Aadhar Card.
Note:
  In case the patient is a minor, Birth Certificate of the patient and the domicile proof of either of the parent (any one of the aforementioned documents).

detailed_description:
The scheme “Distress Relief Fund for the Differently Abled (Medical Treatment)” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala. As per [G.O.(MS) 4/95 SWD](http://sjd.kerala.gov.in/DOCUMENTS/Order_new/GOs/11544.pdf) dated 24-01-1995, the Government of Kerala sanctioned the Distress Relief Fund for disabled persons. An amount of Rupees One crore has been deposited in Treasury as a corpus fund. The interest accrued from the fund is being utilized for giving financial assistance to disabled persons for the following purposes:
1.	For medical treatment, including surgery.
2.	To persons who become handicapped due to accidents.
3.	For any other purpose which is not covered by the existing schemes for the handicapped.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹5,000/- per person in a year will be given to the disabled person or who has become handicapped for their medical treatment, including surgery.

name: Cancer Suraksha Scheme
tags: Cancer, Patients, Free Treatment, BPL, Hospital
brief_description: The Government of Kerala launched the “Cancer Suraksha Scheme” on 1st November 2008 for children below the age of 18 who suffer from cancer and belong to such families which are too poor to afford treatment. This scheme was launched under Kerala Social Security Mission.
detailed_description:
The Government of Kerala launched the “Cancer Suraksha Scheme” on 1st November 2008 for children below the age of 18 who suffer from cancer and belong to such families which are too poor to afford treatment. This scheme was launched under Kerala Social Security Mission. Those patients found eligible would be registered under the scheme and a Patient Card would be issued. Registered patients would be provided treatment free of cost at the designated hospitals. On further verification, if it is found that any registered patient is ineligible for assistance, the assistance would be stopped forthwith.
             Cancer, the killer disease, was once considered incurable. However, advances in medical science have helped conquer the disease to a very large extent. It is scientifically proven that pediatric cases of cancer are largely curable if treated early. Recognizing the urgent need to extend financial support to cancer victims from families, who are too poor to afford treatment, the Government of Kerala launched this scheme.
            To provide cashless transactions funds have already been deposited with the superintendents of the hospitals. The patients who are eligible for assistance would receive the benefit from these hospitals directly without approaching the Mission.
**Hospitals Covered under the Scheme:**

   1. Regional Cancer Centre, Thiruvananthapuram
   1. Government Medical College Thiruvananthapuram
   1. Sree AvitamThirunal (SAT) Hospital, Thiruvananthapuram
   1. Government Medical College Alapuzha
   1. Government Medical College Kottayam
   1. Government Medical College Thrissur
   1. Government Medical College Kozhikode
   1. Co-operative Medical College Pariyaram, Kannur
   1. Malabar Cancer Centre, Thalassery, Kannur
   1. Government General Hospital, Ernakulam
   1. Institute of Maternal and Child Health, Kozhikode
   1. Govt. Medical College Hospital, Ernakulam
benefits:
1. Under this scheme, children under 18 years would be given free treatment for cancer through designated Government hospitals in the state.
   1. The entire cost of treatment, including the cost of investigations, would be borne by the hospitals through the funds provided by the Mission.
   1. The ceiling of expenditure per child would be initially ₹50,000/-.

**Note:** The hospital can incur additional expenditure, based on the report of the committee comprising the Oncologist/treating doctor, the Head of the Radiology Department, and the Superintendent, subject to ratification by the Mission.

8.	Registered Patient Card under the scheme

brief_description: The scheme provides free medical facilities to press correspondents and members of their families in Government hospitals /institutions under the control of the Administration. detailed_description: The scheme "Free Medical Card for Media Persons" by the Department of Information & Publicity, Union Territory of Puducherry, aims to provide free medical facilities to press correspondents and members of their families in Government hospitals /institutions under the control of the Administration. This will include free treatment in the Government hospitals /institutions of Puducherry with entitlement to A-Class Special Wards.
benefits:
Identification Cards/Certificates will be issued to the eligible media persons for availing the following facilities - 

- Free medical facilities to the press correspondents and members of their families in Government hospitals /institutions under the control of the Administration. 
- Free treatment in the Government hospitals /institutions of Puducherry with entitlement of 'A-Class' Special Wards. In the absence of such wards, wards of the next lower category shall be provided.
- The free medical facility will also include hospital stoppages, investigation charges, etc.

**Time of Disbursal:** The Medical Card will be issued within a working day from the date of application.

Nativity and Nationality Certificate (
Form-II
), from an officer of the Revenue Department not below the rank of a Deputy Tahsildar. 
Media Person's Identity Card, issued by the Directorate of Information and Publicity, Puducherry. 
Two Passport Size Photographs.

detailed_description:
The Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana was initiated by the Department of Women, Child Development, and Social Security, Government of Jharkhand. The objective of the Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana is to address negative perceptions about the birth of daughters in society, issues like female foeticide, child marriage, low female child sex ratio, and the weak educational status of girls. The scheme has been approved across the entire state of Jharkhand to address these issues. The objectives of this scheme are as follows:
Objectives of the Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana: > (a) Women's empowerment > (b) Emphasis on girls’ education > (c) Eradication of the child marriage practice > (d) Support for the educational expenses of girls in higher classes to reduce school dropout rates and encourage them towards higher education. > (e) Assistance for adolescent girls' health and personal hygiene. > (f) Enable adolescent girls to make independent decisions regarding their lives.

detailed_description: The &quot;Poshan Sudha&quot; scheme launched by the Women and Child Development Department, Gujarat, aimed at providing nutritional support to pregnant and lactating mothers in Gujarat’s tribal districts. This initiative provides registered mothers with one nutritious meal daily, iron and calcium supplements, and health education to improve maternal and child health outcomes.
benefits: - **Nutritional Support:** Provision of one full nutritious meal daily for pregnant and lactating mothers. Supply of iron and calcium supplements to address nutritional deficiencies.  - **Health Education:** Awareness sessions on health and nutrition for better maternal and child care.
documents_required:
Proof of identity (e.g., Aadhaar Card).
Proof of residence.
Medical certificate of being pregnant.
Any other document (if required).
application_process:
Offline
Step 1:
 Visit the nearest Anganwadi center.
Step 2:
 Register yourself with the Anganwadi center.
Step 3:
 Provide the required documents.
Step 4:
 Avail of the benefits during scheduled distribution days.

**Step 3:** Provide the required documents.
**Step 4:** Avail of the benefits during scheduled distribution days.

name: Khel Chhatravriti (Vritika) Yojana
tags: Financial Assistance, Sportsperson, Career, Scholarship
brief_description: The "Khel Chhatravriti (Vritika) Yojana" implemented by the Directorate of Art, Culture, Sports, and Youth Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, provides financial assistance to athletes based on their performance to encourage sports as a career.

name: Ganga Swarupa Punah Lagna Arthik Sahay Scheme
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
tags: Widow, Women, Remarriage Assistance
brief_description: The scheme supports remarried women who are beneficiaries of the Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme, aiming to reintegrate them into society with financial support.

name: Jharkhand State Migrant Labourers Survey and Rehabilitation Scheme
tags: Financial Assistance, Rehabilitation, Migrant Worker, Death
brief_description: The "Jharkhand State Migrant Labourers Survey and Rehabilitation Scheme" aims to identify and support migrant workers from the state. The scheme ensures social security, rehabilitation, and welfare for migrant workers and their families.

name: Gausevak Training (Initial and Refresher)
tags: Educated, Unemployed, Youth, Training
brief_description: The scheme "Gausevak Training (Initial and Refresher)" aims to empower educated unemployed rural youth with self-employment opportunities and the skills to provide primary veterinary services in remote rural areas. A 100% stipend of ₹6,000 for initial training and ₹500 for refresher training.

name: Civil Service Incentive Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
tags: Scheduled Caste, Student, Scheduled Tribe, Education, Examination
brief_description: The "Civil Service Incentive Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)" scheme by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department of the Government of Madhya Pradesh provides an incentive amount to encourage SC/ST candidates to appear in Civil Services Examinations.

name: Tap Water Scheme (Nal Jal Yojana)
tags: Water, Agriculture, Panchayat, Development, Rural
brief_description: "Tap Water Scheme" (नल जल योजना) by the Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide clean water in Gram Panchayat areas in an accessible manner. The application has to be made to the concerned Gram Panchayat.

name: Mukhyamantri Gramin Peyjal Nishchay Yojana
tags: Water Supply, Drinking Water, Rural Development
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide pure drinking water through pipelines to every rural household in Bihar. This initiative started in 2016 with a focus on community involvement, local governance, and sustainable water management.

name: Satat Jeevikoparjan Yojana (SJY)
tags: Livelihood Support, Capacity Building, Rural Development, Skill Upgradation, Training
brief_description: "Satat Jeevikoparjan Yojana (SJY)" is a flagship program launched by the Government of Bihar to uplift ultra-poor households through comprehensive livelihood support, skill-building, and financial inclusion.

name: Salt Distribution Scheme Jharkhand
tags: Subsidized Rate, Salt, JSFSS, NFSA
brief_description: The "Salt Distribution Scheme" by the Department of Food, Public Distribution and Consumer Affairs, Government of Jharkhand, ensures subsidized salt is provided to AAY, PHH, and Green Cardholders, promoting accessibility and affordability.

name: Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY)
tags: Housing, Citizen Empowerment
brief_description: "Banglar Awaas Yojana (BAY)" provides financial assistance to houseless households and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses, helping them build pucca houses with essential amenities. The scheme offers financial assistance with additional support for toilets and unskilled workdays.

name: Running of Scheduled Caste Hostel
tags: Hostel, Housing, Scheduled Caste, Student
brief_description: The "Running of Scheduled Caste Hostels" scheme by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide housing and a conducive study environment for Scheduled Caste students. Separate junior, senior, and college hostels are operated for boys & girls.

name: Excellent Work Award Scheme for Social Worker of De-Notified Communities
tags: Award, Social Worker, Financial Assistance, Denotified
brief_description: The "Excellent Work Award Scheme for Social Workers of De-notified Communities" by the Government of Madhya Pradesh awards ₹1,00,000/- to a social worker from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities for outstanding contributions to their social and economic upliftment.

name: Scheme of Post Matric Scholarship to Lower Income Group Student for Studies in India
tags: Post Matric, Scholarship, Education, Financial Assistance, School, College
brief_description: The scheme "Post Matric Scholarship to Lower Income Group Students for Studies in India" aims to provide financial assistance to students from the Lower Income Groups to enable them to complete their education. Students are provided maintenance allowances, tuition fees, and additional benefits.

name: Mukhyamantri Awas Yojna (HPBOCWWB)
tags: Construction Workers, Building Worker, Housing Assistance, Labour
brief_description: The Mukhyamantri Awas Yojna, introduced by the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB), provides financial assistance of ₹1,50,000/- to registered worker.

name: INDIRAMMA Widow Pension (Rural)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
tags: Widow, Pension, Rural, Village
brief_description: "INDIRAMMA Weavers Pension (Rural)" scheme aims to disburse monthly pensions to widows, irrespective of their age. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, be a resident of the district, and not be covered under any other Pension Scheme.

name: Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme
tags: Backward Classes, Foreign Study, Scholarship, Students, Financial Support
brief_description: Launched on 1st January 2007, the "Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme" by the Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides financial assistance to backward class students for postgraduate, Ph.D., and post-research studies abroad.

name: Empower ST/SC Communities using ICT Tools through IT Knowledge Centre (ITKC)
tags: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Skill, Knowledge, Literacy
brief_description: "Empower ST/SC Communities using ICT Tools through IT Knowledge Centre (ITKC)" by the Department of Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Government of Goa aims to create a large pool of computer literate manpower and to make introducing e-governance solutions meaningful.

name: Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools
tags: Education, Student, Sainik, Nomadic, School, Military
brief_description: The "Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, reimburses tuition fees for eligible students enrolled in Sainik Schools or Institutions.

name: INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Urban)
tags: Pension, Senior Citizen, Urban, Old Age, Financial Assistance
brief_description: "INDIRAMMA Old Age Pension (Urban)" scheme aims to provide monthly pensions to destitute elderly persons aged 65 years or above with little or no means of subsistence and no family or relative to depend upon. To be eligible, they should be from a BPL family, and be a resident of Andhra Pradesh.

name: Laptop Supply Scheme
tags: Education, Student, School, Laptop
brief_description: "Laptop Supply Scheme" by the School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides ₹25,000/- for purchasing a laptop to students who score 80% or more in 12th Standard from a Government Higher Secondary School or a Madhya Pradesh Board (MP Board) affiliated school.

name: Financial Assistance to Widower and Unmarried Persons Scheme : For Unmarried
tags: Unmarried, Financial Assistance, Social Security, Empowerment
brief_description: The aim of the scheme is to provide Social Security to Unmarried Persons who are unable to sustain themselves from their own sources and are in need of financial assistance from the State.

name: Schemes for welfare of School Children belonging to BPL and BC(A) families: Monthly Stipend for BPL Students
tags: BPL, Student, Stipend, Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from BPL students to support their education. Under this scheme, a monthly stipend is provided to students studying in classes 1 to 12 in Haryana Government schools.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Self Employment Programme for Transgender
tags: Self-employment, Business, Transgender, Financial Assistance, Loan
brief_description: The scheme objective is to provide financial assistance to transgender individuals for self-employment/business establishment. Eligible beneficiaries can receive up to ₹50,000/- or 25% of the project cost.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Training Programme for Transgender
tags: Financial Assistance, Skill Training, Employment Opportunity, Transgender, Skill Development, Vocational Training, Technical Training
brief_description: The scheme aims to support the socio-economic development of transgender individuals by providing financial assistance, skill training, and employment opportunities.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Antyodaya Parivar Suraksha Yojana (DAYALU-II)
tags: Financial Assistance, Accidental Death, Permanent Disability, Dog Bite, Stay Animals, DAYALU-II, Stray Cattle
brief_description: The aim of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to residents of Haryana in case of accidental death or permanent disability occurred due to stray cattle/animal such as such as cow, bull, oxen, donkey, dog bite, mule, nilgai and buffalo that roam freely.

name: Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC
tags: Financial Assistance, PhD, Student, Scheduled Caste, International
brief_description: The "Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC" Scheme by the Rajasthan Social Justice and Empowerment Department provides financial assistance to meritorious SC students for pursuing Ph.D. studies in foreign universities in Humanities and Social Sciences.

name: Kisan Parivahan Yojana
tags: Agriculture, Farmer, Heavy Farm Equipment, Goods Vehicles
brief_description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for purchasing medium-sized goods vehicles to facilitate the transportation of agricultural produce.

name: Financial Assistance to SC Students for Pursuing Higher Studies Abroad
tags: College, Scheduled Caste, Student, Scholarship, Abroad, Foreign, Education
brief_description: The scheme aims to support SC students for higher education abroad in fields like Engineering, Sciences, and Humanities. Benefits include up to ₹20,00,000/- for Ph.D. and ₹10,00,000 for Masters, with eligibility criteria including residency and income below ₹8,00,000/-.

name: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to Farmers for Purchasing Sanedo Agricultural Equipment
tags: Agriculture, Farmer, Sanedo Equipment
brief_description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for purchasing Sanedo (Mini Tractor) equipment, which enhances efficiency and reduces labor dependency in farming operations.

name: Scheme for Assistance on Purchase of Smartphone by the Farmers
tags: Agriculture, Farmer, Smartphone
brief_description: This scheme has been introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Dept., Gujarat. It aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for purchasing smartphones, enabling them to access agricultural technology, weather updates, pest control techniques, and government assistance.

name: Additional Financial Assistance for the Children of Persons Engaged in the Cleaning Profession
tags: Scholarship, Post-Matric, Sanitation Worker, Scavenger, Student
brief_description: This scheme aims to provide additional financial assistance of ₹500/- per month to children of individuals working in cleaning/sanitation profession. This assistance is given to students already receiving a scholarship under Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme, ensuring their continued education.

name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - College/Higher/Technical Educational Fees Refund for Transgender Students
tags: Transgender, Educational Fees, Reimbursement Of Fees, Higher Education, Technical Education, Student
brief_description: The scheme aims to promote higher and technical education among transgender individuals by providing financial assistance for their educational expenses. Under this scheme, transgender students receive a refund of their school, college, higher, or technical education fees.

name: Marriage Assistance Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
tags: Construction, Worker, Labour, Marriage, Financial Assistance
brief_description: The scheme provides financial assistance for the marriage of a registered female worker herself (including one-time remarriage) and for up to two daughters of a registered worker. The scheme applies to the marriage of the female beneficiary herself and the legal, adopted, or stepdaughter of worker.

name: Union Territory of Lakshadweep Pension Scheme for Widows
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
tags: Widow, Financial Assistance, Pension
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500/- to widows in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. It covers widows who have not remarried and have no source of income.

name: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana
tags: Horticulture, Farmer, Agriculture, Vegetable Grower, Fruits, Vegetables, Incentive
brief_description: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Haryana, aims to protect horticultural farmers from market price fluctuations and compensate them if they receive low prices for their produce in the market.

name: Free Supply of Text Books
tags: Student, Education, School, Book, Financial Assistance
brief_description: The scheme provides textbooks or cash subsidies for textbooks and writing materials to students of Government and Aided Schools. Benefits include financial assistance ranging from ₹550/- to ₹830/- per annum, with additional support for geometry boxes. All students from Nursery to 12th are eligible.

name: Diesel VAT Relief Scheme for Fishermen
tags: Agriculture, Fishing Activities, Fishermen
brief_description: The "Diesel VAT Relief Scheme for Fishermen" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to provide financial assistance by subsidizing the VAT levied on high-speed diesel used in fishing boats.

name: Mukhyamantri Atyant Pichhda Varg Medhavriti Yojana
tags: Financial Assistance, Student, Extremely Backward Class, Matric
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide ₹10,000/- as a one-time scholarship to extremely backward class students passing class 10th in the first division from the Bihar School Examination Board.

name: Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm
tags: Animal Husbandry, Rural Employment, Animal Farm
brief_description: The "Establishment of 1 to 20 Milch Animal Farm" scheme introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, provides financial assistance in the form of an interest subsidy to livestock farmers to take up animal husbandry as a sustainable business.

name: Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education
tags: Scholarship, Student, Vocational Education, Ex-servicemen, Technical Education
brief_description: Under this scheme, a scholarship of ₹15,000 per year is provided to the children of ex-servicemen, from the rank of Sepoy to Havildar, who are pursuing vocational & technical education & have not received scholarship assistance under the Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme or from any other source.

name: Intensive Castration Scheme
tags: Animal Husbandry, Cow, Low Genetic Animal
brief_description: The "Intensive Castration Scheme" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to control the stray animal population by castrating male calves and helps in reducing accidents caused by stray male animals in rural and urban areas.

name: Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (Scheduled Caste Category)
tags: Animal Husbandry, Cattle Development, Milk Production, Concentrate Feeds
brief_description: The scheme "Assistance of Concentrate Feed After Parturition (Scheduled Caste Category)" provides 150 kg of BIS Type II concentrate feed to Scheduled Caste Category livestock owners after parturition to support cattle health, increase milk production, and enhance calf development.

name: Assistance of Concentrate Feed for Pregnant Animals (General Category)
tags: Animal Husbandry, Pregnant Cattle, Milk Production
brief_description: This scheme provides free BIS type II concentrate feed to pregnant cattle owned by General Category livestock owners in Gujarat to ensure their good health, boost immunity, prevent metabolic diseases, and enhance milk production.

name: BC & EBC Girls Residential +2 High School
tags: Financial Assistance, Girl Student, Backward Class, Extremely Backward Class, Vocational Training, Free Accommodation, Hostel
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide quality education and holistic development opportunities for girls from backward and extremely backward classes. Free education, accommodation, study material, medical support, and skill development programs are provided.

name: Educational Study Scheme
category: Education & Learning, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Social welfare & Empowerment
tags: Study Loan, Education, Tuition Fee
brief_description: The "Educational Study Scheme" provides financial assistance in the form of loans for self-supporting graduate-level courses in professional fields such as Medical, Dental, Engineering, Technology, Pharmacy, Architecture, Nursing, Homeopathy, Veterinary, and similar disciplines.

name: Aapki Beti Yojana
tags: Financial Assistance, Girl Student, BPL, Below Poverty Line, Daughter
brief_description: Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹2,100/- per year is provided to girls studying in Class 1 to 8 in government schools, belonging to families living below the poverty line (BPL) and whose both or one parent has passed away. Girls studying in Class 9 to 12 receive ₹2,500/- per year.

name: The Goa State Photo Contest And Exhibition Scheme
tags: Exhibition, Photography, Photojournalism, Contest
brief_description: The scheme aims to encourage local youths in photography and photojournalism, providing cash prizes and exhibition opportunities. The scheme offers cash prizes of ₹20,000/-, ₹16,000/-, and ₹12,000/- in each category. Entries from applicants born and residing in Goa are preferred.

name: Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole
tags: Agriculture, Animal Husbandry, Cattle Development
brief_description: The "Scheme for Upgradation of Gaushala/ Panjrapole"  aims to promote indigenous cow breeds and make cow rearing economically viable.

name: Merit Scholarship: Engineering University
tags: Education, Student, Scholarship, Engineering, University
brief_description: The scheme provides ₹1000/- per month to eligible students for pursuing B.E. from a recognized engineering college in Chhattisgarh.  The applicants can either be students who have passed their 10th and 12th standard examinations, or Diploma holders newly admitted to the second year of B.E.

name: Merit Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions
tags: Student, Education, Scholarship, Financial Support, Polytechnic
brief_description: "Merit Scholarship: Polytechnic Institutions" is a scholarship scheme by the Technical Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh. The scheme provides ₹600/- per month to eligible students for pursuing education from recognized polytechnic institutions in Chhattisgarh.

name: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
tags: Pension, Widow, Freedom Fighter
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹25,000/- to the freedom fighters of Uttarakhand and to the widows of deceased freedom fighters, in recognition of their contribution to the nation.

name: Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana
tags: Scholarship, Student, Talent Search, Secondary Education, Higher Education
brief_description: Under this scheme, students are provided with scholarships or a one-time incentive for pursuing education up to the postgraduate level, after being selected through the State Talent Search Examination organized by the Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan, Ajmer.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Punjab)
tags: Pension, Old Age, Below Poverty Line, BPL, Senior Citizen
brief_description: In this scheme, persons aged between 60 and 79 years receive a pension of ₹200/- per month, while those aged 80 years and above receive ₹500/- per month. The scheme applies only to persons belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Punjab)
tags: Pension, Indira Gandhi, Disability, PwD
brief_description: The "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)" provides ₹300/- per month to disabled persons (80% or more disability) aged 18 and above. After age 80, the amount increases to ₹500/-. Dwarfs are also eligible.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (Punjab)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
tags: Pension, Widow, Woman, Female
brief_description: "Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)" provides a pension of ₹300/- per month to widows aged 40 years and above. After attaining the age of 80 years, the pension amount increases to ₹500/- per month.

name: Subsidy to Purchase E-Bike for Journalists
tags: Subsidy, Transport, Journalist, Environment, Pollution, Road
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to journalists in Goa for purchasing e-bikes at a subsidised rate. The benefits include making it more convenient for journalists to gather and disseminate news, with the intended beneficiaries being eligible Goa-based journalists.

name: Patrakar Kritadnyata Nidhi Scheme (Journalist Benevolent Fund)
category: Science, IT & Communications, Social welfare & Empowerment
tags: Journalist, Financial Assistance, Education, Marriage, Medical
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to journalists in Goa for emergencies like medical treatment, marriage, and education. Benefits include aid up to ₹2,00,000/and scholarships for dependents. Eligible journalists must be registered and working in Goa for at least three years.

name: The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme
tags: Journalist, Media, Award, Cash, Newspaper
brief_description: "The Goa State Journalist Awards Scheme" aims to encourage journalists to publish commendable news items, articles, or reports, fostering mass awareness. It provides awards, including a cash prize of ₹10,000/-, to eligible journalists in Goa.

name: Travel Grants To Goan Authors
category: Transport & Infrastructure, Travel & Tourism, Sports & Culture
tags: Travel, Grant, Author, Culture, Artist
brief_description: The objective of the scheme is to enable the Goan writers to come in close contact with the senior writers of a language-region other than their own within India to acquaint them with the writers and the people of that region, and to widen their awareness and sensibility about the country.

name: Rajasthan Varishth Patrakar Samman Yojana
tags: Financial Assistance, Journalist, Senior Citizen, Honorarium
brief_description: Under this scheme, a monthly financial assistance of ₹15,000/- is provided to full-time accredited journalists who are 60 years of age or older & have served continuously for at least 20 years in daily, weekly, fortnightly newspapers, independent publications, electronic media, or news agencies.

name: Bhajan Pakhawaj Workshops
tags: Culture, Artist, Bhajan, Workshop, Skill
brief_description: The objective of the scheme is to provide knowledge of appropriate and traditional Bhajan Singing and Pakhawaj playing to Bhajan performers through experts from the respective field. Applications are invited by announcement in local print & electronic media. Certificates are awarded to participants.

name: Laado Protsahan Yojana
tags: Financial Assistance, Maternity, Childcare, Girl Child, Education
brief_description: The scheme aims to encourage the birth of girl children in poor families and promote their holistic development. Under this scheme, financial support ₹1,50,000/- is provided in seven installments to the parents or guardians of girls born in Government/authorized Medical Institutions.

name: Pension Scheme for State Agitators Other Than Category of Agitators Who Went to Jail for 7 Days or got Injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement
tags: Pension, Agitator, Uttarakhand State Movement
brief_description: The scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹4,500/- to state agitators not imprisoned for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement, who are not eligible for any other government pension and are not employed in government service.

name: Samajik Sewa Bhatta Scheme
tags: Pension, Traditional Faith Healers, Financial Assistance
brief_description: The scheme aims to support traditional faith healers by providing a monthly pension. Under this scheme, ₹1,500 is provided to each eligible traditional healer across the state.

name: Tiatr Cantaram Singing Competition
tags: Academy, Financial Support, Award, Artist, Singing, Competition
brief_description: The "Tiatr Cantaram Singing Competition", organised by the Kala Academy under the Department of Art, Culture and Museums, Government of Goa, aims to promote singing talent, preserve and revive the tradition of Tiatr songs, and encourage both traditional and new compositions that reflect Goa.

name: Operation of Sports Hostels
tags: Hostel, Scheduled Tribe, Sports Training, Sports, Tribal Students
brief_description: The scheme aims to encourage tribal students to participate in sports and prepare them for national & international competitions. Tribal students from Classes 6 to 12 are provided with free accommodation, specialized training, nutritious meals & other necessary facilities in the sports hostels.

name: Organisation of Cultural Programs
tags: Cultural Programs, Artists, Cultural Groups, Culture
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to cultural groups and artists registered with the Department for performing in cultural programs organized during traditional fairs, festivals, regional celebrations within and outside the state, as well as on the occasion of national festivals.

name: ICSSR Doctoral Fellowship
tags: ICSSR Fellowships, Doctoral Fellowship, Social Science Research, PhD, Research Scholars
brief_description: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) offers Doctoral Fellowships to support full-time Ph.D. scholars engaged in high-quality research in the field of social and human sciences. These fellowships are awarded to Indian research scholars registered in Ph.D. programs at UGC-recognized u

name: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (EBC)
tags: Housing, Economically Weaker Section, Social Welfare, Shelter, Home, EWS
brief_description: The scheme aims to support Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) by offering financial aid up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction. This scheme also ensures that Economically Weaker Sections receive support in securing shelter.

name: Kailash Darshan Yatra
tags: Travel, Tourism, Pilgrim, Culture, Heritage
brief_description: The scheme provides financial assistance to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the Kailash Darshan Yatra. To be eligible, the applicant must be a selected pilgrim from Gujarat and submit proof of yatra completion within 90 days. Applications for this scheme are accepted offline.

name: Printing and Free Distribution of Sanskrit Textbooks
tags: Free Textbooks Of Sanskrit, Student, Printing Sanskrit Textbooks, Sanskrit
brief_description: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education by providing free Sanskrit textbooks to students studying in Classes 1 to 12. Under this scheme, annual financial assistance ranging from ₹250/- to ₹700/- is provided to each student enrolled in Classes 1 to 12 of Sanskrit schools.

name: Protection Against Domestic Violence
category: Women and Child, Public Safety,Law & Justice
tags: Women Protection, Domestic Violence, Counseling, Mediation
brief_description: The scheme "Protection Against Domestic Violence" by the Women and Child Development Department, Government of Haryana, aims to provide legal, emotional, and social support to women facing domestic violence through grievance redressal, offering protection, counseling, and mediation to victims.

name: Sero Positive Illness Scheme
tags: Sero Disease, Children, Scholarship, Education
brief_description: The scheme "Sero Positive Illness Scheme" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat aims to provide educational scholarships to orphaned and destitute children affected by Sero Positive illness.

name: Sindhu Darshan Scheme
tags: Culture, Pilgrim, Heritage, Pilgrimage, Travel, Tourism
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹15,000/- to pilgrims from Gujarat undertaking the Sindhu Darshan Yatra in Leh-Ladakh, fostering national unity. Intended beneficiaries include native Gujaratis who complete the yatra and apply within 60 days.

name: Self-Employment Scheme for Scheduled Castes and Tribes
category: Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance
tags: Self-employment, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, BPL, Loan, Subsidy
brief_description: The scheme aims to support scheduled castes and scheduled tribes families below the poverty line through concessional loans and subsidies for self-employment in various sectors.

name: PMMSY: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day - Haryana
category: Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Business & Entrepreneurship, Social welfare & Empowerment
tags: Fish, Affordable Feed, Capital Subsidy, FFPO
brief_description: This scheme provides capital subsidy for setting up fish feed plants with a minimum production capacity of 100 tons per day, under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) to general , schedule caste and women beneficiaries .

name: Varanasi and Amritsar Yatra Scheme
tags: Journey, Pilgrim, Travel, Pilgrimage, Scheduled Caste
brief_description: This scheme aims to facilitate pilgrimages to Varanasi and Amritsar for individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes category. The scheme provides financial reimbursement for second-class train travel, enabling eligible beneficiaries to undertake these religious journeys with ease.

name: State Art Exhibition Competition
tags: State Art Exhibition, Fine Arts Competition, Awards, Cash Prize, Artist Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme "State Art Exhibition Competition" by the Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department, Government of Gujarat aims to promote fine arts and recognize artistic talents by providing awards and scholarships to artists, art students, and school children across Gujarat.

name: Handicraft Mela Participation
tags: Handicraft, Exhibition, Artisan, SHG, Embroidery, Pottery
brief_description: The scheme enables artisans and handicraft organizations to participate in government-sponsored melas across Gujarat and other states, fostering market access and preserving traditional crafts. Benefits include subsidized stall fees, promotional support, sales opportunities for handmade products.

name: Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme
tags: Yarn, Subsidy, Silk, Jute, Freight, Handloom
brief_description: The scheme provides 15% subsidy on yarn purchases from NHDC depots to handloom weavers, cooperatives, and NGOs, along with freight reimbursement (1–8.5%). Intended beneficiaries include weavers below the poverty line.

name: PMMSY: Establishment of New Freshwater Fin Fish Hatcheries-Haryana
tags: Financial Assistance, Subsidy, Setting Up, Hatcheries
brief_description: The scheme aims to support the establishment of new freshwater finfish hatcheries. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to beneficiaries for setting up these hatcheries.

name: PMMSY: Live Fish Vending Centres Scheme - Haryana

name: Mukhyamantri Bal Hridaya Upchar Yojana
tags: Child, Surgery, Financial Aid, Disease, Treatment
brief_description: The scheme provides financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- for treatment, covering 07 identified heart diseases in children. Key features include covering costs for treatment at recognized government or private hospitals.
detailed_description: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Bal Hridaya Upchar Yojana" was launched by the Public Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide free treatment and surgery to children aged 0 to 15 years who are suffering from identified heart diseases. The scheme provides financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- for treatment, covering 07 identified heart diseases in children. Key features include covering costs for treatment at recognized government or private hospitals and ensuring the process is governed by the Madhya Pradesh Public Services Guarantee Act, 2010.
benefits: - Financial assistance ranging from ₹25,000/- to ₹1,00,000/- per case for treatment. - Provision of free treatment/surgery for 07 identified heart diseases in children. - The sanctioned amount is transferred to the account of the concerned medical institution via Cheque or E-Payment (e-transfer). - The benefit delivery period is stipulated as 20 working days. ***Conditions*** - Treatment must be confined to the approved package amount. - Hospitals must not demand any additional fee from the patient for treatment beyond the sanctioned amount. - The beneficiary or hospital must submit a detailed expenditure report/utilization certificate for the funds spent on the patient's treatment. - A duplicate or photocopy of the discharge ticket issued after the patient's recovery must be provided.

During Application

Step 2: In the registration page, provide the following mandatory information: Name, Gender, Mobile No., Email ID. Step 3: Create a new password and confirm the same. Fill the captcha code. Verify your Mobile Number via OTP. Finally, click "Register". Application Step 1: Visit the Official Website of " Madhya Pradesh Lok Sewa Guarantee Portal " and click " लॉग इन (Login) ". Prescribed Format of the Application Form (For Offline Application). Link to Apply Online (By Self or Through Lok Sewa Kendra / MP Online / CSC). name: Mukhyamantri Sudharit Kamdhenu Scheme
tags: Farmer, Youth, Dairy, Subsidy, Cattle
brief_description: The scheme aims to help the farmers to get financial assistance for the purchase of cross bred cows, improved she buffaloes and cows of indigenous breeds namely Sahiwal, Gir, Red Sindhi, Rathi and Tharparkar for their Dairy Unit, to promote self employment in the Dairy Sector.

name: ST Girl Child Literacy Incentive Amount - Class 11th
tags: Education, Girl Student, Scholarship
brief_description: The scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe girl students of Madhya Pradesh enrolled in Class 11 to encourage them to continue their education and prevent dropouts.

name: Saral Bijli Bill Scheme
tags: Electricity, Subsidy
brief_description: The scheme offers free domestic connections and a fixed monthly charge to ensure easy electricity access for eligible beneficiaries.

name: Scheme for Persons with Benchmark Disability Requiring High Support
tags: Disability, PwD, Grant, Financial Assistance, Rehabilitation, Education
brief_description: The scheme aims to promote economic self-reliance and ensure the well-being of persons with benchmark disabilities requiring high support. It provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹40,000/- to eligible applicants who are bonafide residents of Goa and belong to the EWS Category.

name: Registration for Crop Procurement
tags: Farmer, Financial Assistance, Crop, Procurement, Grain
brief_description: The scheme aims to ensure fair crop prices for farmers by facilitating government procurement and provides easy online registration for landholding farmers to sell their crops at minimum support price.

name: Sanitary Napkin Distribution - Uttarakhand
tags: Sanitary Napkin, Adolescent Girls, Girl
brief_description: The scheme aims to promote menstrual hygiene and prevent reproductive tract infections among adolescent girls aged 10 to 19 years in Uttarakhand by providing sanitary napkins at a nominal cost of ₹6/-, available through all ASHA workers across the state.
detailed_description: The scheme “Sanitary Napkin Distribution” is an initiative under the National Health Mission (NHM) implemented by the Department of Medical Health and Family Welfare, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote menstrual hygiene and prevent reproductive tract infections among adolescent girls aged 10 to 19 years in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this scheme, to prevent reproductive tract infections and inculcate menstrual hygiene habits, sanitary napkins are provided to adolescent girls by ASHA workers at a nominal cost of ₹6/-.
documents_required: No documents are required to avail the benefits of this scheme.
application_process: Offline Sanitary napkins are available with all ASHA workers across Uttarakhand. Sanitary napkins are available with all ASHA workers across Uttarakhand.

name: Raah-Veer Yojana
tags: Citizens, Award, Financial Assistance, Accident, Save Lives
brief_description: The scheme encourages citizens to help road accident victims during emergencies by providing a ₹25,000 incentive to individuals who save lives through timely medical assistance.

name: Eja-Boi Shagun Yojana
tags: Mother, Newborn, Childbirth, Childcare, Pregnant Woman
brief_description: The scheme aims to promote the safe health and well-being of mothers and newborns by encouraging institutional deliveries and ensuring that mothers stay in government hospitals for at least 48 hours after childbirth.

name: Immunization Programme - Uttarakhand
tags: Child, Free Vaccination, Childcare, Health, Immunization
brief_description: This initiative aims to protect every child from preventable, life-threatening diseases by providing free and timely vaccination as per the National Immunization Schedule.

This initiative aims to protect every child from preventable, life-threatening diseases by providing free and timely vaccination as per the National Immunization Schedule.

name: Hybrid Chilli Production Program
tags: Hybrid Chilli Production, Financial Assistance, Horticulture
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide self-employment opportunities and increase income for Scheduled Caste farmers living below the poverty line by promoting hybrid chilli cultivation.

name: Mukhyamantri Ghasyari Kalyan Yojana
tags: Silage, Animal Feed, Fodder, Livestock Farmer, Cattle Rearer
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide affordable and nutritious packed silage and total mixed animal feed to livestock farmers, especially women, in the remote hilly areas of Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, silage is made available to livestock farmers at a subsidized rate of ₹2.75 per kg.

name: Award of Cash Incentive to the Toppers at Regional Level and Students Scoring Centum in the Subjects Involving Theory in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Public Examinations in Government Schools in the Union Territory of Puducherry
tags: Student, Cash, Award, School, Education
brief_description: The scheme aims to award cash incentives to encourage students in their education by recognizing top three regional rank holders and those scoring centum in theory subjects in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Exams in Govt. Schools.

name: District Plan: Inter-Village Road Construction Scheme on Contributory Basis
tags: Road Construction, Sugar Transportation, Sugarcane, Farmer, Sugar Mill
brief_description: The scheme aims to facilitate the easy and timely transportation of sugarcane from farms to purchasing centers and sugar mills by improving inter-village road connectivity in sugarcane-growing areas.

name: Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Power Plant Scheme - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency
tags: UREDA, Solar, Solar Power Plant, Grid Connected Rooftop, Electricity
brief_description: The scheme aims to promote the adoption of rooftop solar energy among domestic consumers in Uttarakhand by providing financial support and enabling them to generate clean, renewable electricity, reduce their electricity bills through net metering.

name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s Yatra Scheme to visit the places connected with Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s life in India
tags: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Travel, Pilgrimage, Transport
brief_description: The scheme aims to assist the people who want to visit the places connected with Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s life in India. It provides comprehensive financial assistance, with all expenses for the tour programme fully borne by the Department, targeting SC/ST applicants of Puducherry.

name: Uttarakhand Mega Industrial and Investment Policy - 2021
tags: Entrepreneur, MSME, Super Ultra Mega Projects, Mega Projects, Capital Investment, Policy
brief_description: The scheme aims to promote large-scale industrial development and investment in the state of Uttarakhand by creating a favourable business environment, encouraging capital investment, and generating employment opportunities.

name: Tribals Development Plan: Subsidy for Purchase of Motorcycle
tags: Tribal, Transport, Subsidy, Employment, Motorcycle
brief_description: The scheme aims to assist tribal families in Goa to purchase motorcycles for self-employment by offering a government subsidy, thereby promoting economic self-reliance among low-income households.

name: Tourist Guide Certification Scheme
tags: Training, Certification, Tourism, Entrepreneurship, Employment
brief_description: The scheme aims to train and certify Goan youth as tourist guides through Basic and Advanced modules. It reimburses fees for the Basic course and sponsors the Advanced curriculum, creating employment and entrepreneurial opportunities in Goa’s tourism sector.

name: Tea Development Programme in the Hilly Districts of Uttarakhand - Uttarakhand Tea Development Board
tags: Tea, Tea Development Board, Farmer, Self-Employment, Tea Plantation, Tea Garden, Tea Industry
brief_description: The scheme aims to promote tea cultivation in the mountainous regions of Uttarakhand, providing sustainable employment, optimal utilization of barren and unused land, and economic upliftment of local farmers.

name: Grant For Oru Kala Pooja
tags: Grant, Temple, Financial Assistance, Religion, Heritage
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide annual financial assistance to Hindu Religious Institutions situated in the Union Territory of Puducherry that have poor resources. It benefits the temple authorities by covering expenses associated with the performance of Oru Kala Pooja, Current Consumption Charges, etc.

name: The Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme
tags: Enterprise, Investment, Employment, Manufacture, Entrepreneur
brief_description: The scheme aims to create sustainable employment, accelerate investment, and support environmentally sustainable industrial development in Goa. It provides financial assistance and incentives under separate target schemes to new and existing Micro, Small, Medium, and Large manufacturing units.

name: Tribals Development Plan: Motor Driving Training [Light & Heavy Vehicles]
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Transport & Infrastructure, Skills & Employment
tags: Subsidy, Training, Tribal, Transport, Vehicle, Livelihood
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide full financial coverage for motor driving training, including courses for Light Motor Vehicles and Heavy Motor Vehicles, specifically recognizing Goa’s future in the transport sector. It benefits eligible Tribal families in Goa whose annual income is below ₹1,20,000/-.

name: Various Training and Support Schemes of Kisan Vigyan Kendra - Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry
tags: Kisan Vigyan Kendra, Training, Farmer, Technical Training, Agriculture, Forestry, Horticulture
brief_description: The scheme aims to enhance the knowledge, skills, and productivity of farmers in Uttarakhand by providing them with the latest technical training in agriculture, horticulture, and forestry.

name: Tea Tourism - Uttarakhand Tea Development Board
tags: Tea, Tourism, Tea Garden, Tea Factory
brief_description: The scheme aims to promote tea tourism in Uttarakhand by attracting visitors to tea gardens and factories, creating local jobs, and supporting the state’s tea industry.

name: Veerjyoti Puraskars
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Public Safety,Law & Justice, Women and Child
tags: Woman, Girl, Award, Prize, Citation, Victim
brief_description: The scheme aims to recognize and award women and girls in the State of Goa who have shown exceptional bravery and courage against atrocities, violence, and/or harassment. It provides a cash prize of ₹20,000/- and a scroll/citation to two awardees annually.

name: Craft & Gear (Unit: Boats of Appropriate Sizes Including Nets, Fish & Ice Holding Boxes, Etc.)
tags: Fisherman, Subsidy, Craft, Gear, Boat
brief_description: The scheme aims to uplift traditional fishermen by providing financial help in the form of a subsidy on the purchase or construction of new wooden or Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic fishing crafts below 26 feet for inland fishing activities in Goa.

name: Grant Scheme for Cultivation of Aromatic Plants - Centre for Aromatic Plants
tags: Aromatic, Farmer, Aromatic Plants, Cultivation, Grant
brief_description: The scheme aims to encourage farmers to adopt the cultivation of commercially valuable aromatic crops such as lemongrass, citronella, palmarosa, khus, damask rose, mint (except Japanese mint), geranium, black cumin, rosemary, bay leaf, timur & sandalwood by providing financial assistance to them.

name: Incentives To Encourage Purchases From Local Suppliers Scheme
category: Business & Entrepreneurship, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance
tags: Manufacturer, MSME, Enterprise, Horticulture, Subsidy, Incentive
brief_description: The scheme aims to encourage consumption through local purchases and support the economies of ancillary units, local Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, and traders. It provides a reimbursement of 2% (up to ₹5,00,000/- annually) on eligible local purchases to eligible manufacturing units in Goa.

name: Financial Assistance For Renovation And Special Repair Works To Hindu Religious Institutions Situated In Economically Weaker Section Areas / Adi-Dravidar Colonies
tags: Temple, Renovation, Repair, Building, Infrastructure
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide one-time financial assistance of ₹2,50,000/- for renovation and special repairs, specifically targeting the purchase of building materials. The intended beneficiaries are Hindu religious institutions situated in Economically Weaker Section Areas or Adi-Dravidar Colonies.

name: Map Simplification Process
tags: Map Simplification, Residential Map, Commercial Map
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide an efficient online system for landowners in Haridwar district to get approval for their residential and commercial property maps quickly and easily, ensuring transparency and reducing delays.

name: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM): Self-Help Group - Uttarakhand
tags: Self-Employment, Loan, Urban Area, Employment, Self-Help Group
brief_description: The scheme aims to empower urban poor women in Uttarakhand by promoting the formation of self-help groups, improving their livelihoods, and supporting them in income-generating and self-employment activities through financial incentives, bank loans, and government subsidies.

name: Simon Sing Horo Special Post-Matric Scholarship
tags: Youth, Scholarship, School, Education, Student
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide a one-time incentive of ₹10,000/- to students of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community who have cleared High School Leaving Certificate or Higher Secondary School Leaving Certificate examinations during the current year.

name: Providing Model Maps for Residential Construction
tags: Map, Model Map, Residential Map
brief_description: It aims to provide landowners in Haridwar district with model maps for residential construction according to the size of their plots.

name: Employment Subsidy Scheme, 2017
tags: Industry, Tourism, Enterprise, Employee, Subsidy, Employment, Investment
brief_description: The scheme aims to create an environment conducive for attracting investment in Goa, incentivise existing units, and boost local employment. It provides a subsidy based on the percentage of Goan employees hired, restricting reimbursement to ₹7,000/- per Goan employee per month.

name: Financial Assistance for ANM/GNM/Technical Courses
tags: Health, Financial Assistance, Medical, Skill, Training, Nurse
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide assistance to the youths of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community for training in job-assured technical and professional Diploma and Degree courses. It supports training for courses like ANM, GNM, and Para-Medical, with a minimum duration of one year.
detailed_description: The scheme "Financial Assistance for ANM/GNM/Technical Courses" was launched by the Tea Tribes Welfare Department, Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide assistance to the youths of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community for training purposes. The scheme provides financial assistance for Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM), General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM), Para-Medical, and other job-assured technical and professional Diploma and Degree courses. The courses must have a minimum duration of one year and be conducted in either Government or Non-Government Institutes. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: - Financial Assistance to the youths of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community for training of Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM)/General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM)/Para-Medical and other job assured technical and professional Diploma and Degree courses. - The training must have a minimum duration of one year and can be conducted in both Government and Non-Government Institutes.

B. Initial Login or Registration: New users must register themselves on the online portal, while existing users will log in using the username and password created during prior registration. C. Selecting the Scheme: Once the applicant is logged into the Dashboard, they must select the appropriate scholarship scheme from the dropdown menu available. Step 2: Entering Personal Details A. Inputting Mandatory Data: Enter "Personal Details" where all required information in the application form must be accurately provided. B. Specifying Location Details: Location data, including District, Assembly Constituency, and Sub-Division, must be selected, along with other essential address details like Village/Town. C. Saving Personal Information: After filling in all necessary fields in this step, click on the "Save Form Details" button to proceed further with the application. Step 3: Document Upload A. Uploading Required Files: Under the "Upload Documents" tab, upload all required supporting documents in the specified image formats (e.g., JPG/JPEG). B. Document Formatting Check: All uploaded documents must adhere to specified maximum file sizes (e.g., photo maximum 50 KB, other documents generally 100 KB) before they can be saved. name: Grants To Patients Suffering From Tuberculosis/Cancer And Other Major Diseases
tags: Health, Financial Assistance, Disease, Education, Student, Cancer, Tuberculosis, Patient
brief_description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for medical treatment to patients suffering from Tuberculosis, Cancer, and other major diseases. It provides a one-time financial grant to patients of the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community.
detailed_description: The scheme "Grants To Patients Suffering From Tuberculosis/Cancer And Other Major Diseases" was launched by the Tea Tribes Welfare Department, Government of Assam. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a one-time grant to patients belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi community who are undergoing medical treatment. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam belonging to the Tea Tribes and Adivasi Community. The applications for this scheme are accepted online.
benefits: Financial assistance (one-time grant) to patients undergoing medical treatment.

name: Aama Kuni Pilaa
tags: Kuni Calendar, Childcare, Toy Kit, Training, Capacity Building, ICDS
brief_description: The scheme aims to focus on early stimulation and responsive parenting in the best interest of each child from 0-3 years. The scheme envisages promoting parent-led, home-based, joyful child-friendly learning by creating an early stimulating environment at the household level.
detailed_description: The scheme “Aama Kuni Pilaa” has been launched by the Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Odisha. It aims to focus on early stimulation and responsive parenting in the best interest of each child from 0-3 years. As the name "Aama Kuni Pilaa” suggests, the unconditional care and affection of parents, grandparents and caregivers for the children is the driving force for the conceptualisation of this unique initiative. Early experiences with mother, father and grandparents shape lifelong learning and development of children, because of rapid brain development. 80% of the brain develops by three years, and stimulating experiences with caregivers strengthen the neural connections, promoting the holistic development of the child. > **Objectives:** The scheme envisages promoting parent-led, home-based, joyful child-friendly learning by creating an early stimulating environment at the household level. It aims at: - Building capacities by engaging parents and caregivers on responsive parenting messages using different platforms. - Skill building of ICDS officials/ caregivers on importance of early years, play and learning activities for children. - Sensitizing the parents, care givers and the entire community on importance of early years. Involvement of father & male care givers through Men-streaming. - Engaging young children with low cost contextual and child friendly toys by the parents & caregivers. - Facilitating love, talk, touch & play through toys, lullabies, stories and interactive talk and activity with children below three years by the Anganwadi worker. - Equity outreach through appropriate parent & caregiver friendly IPC, IEC/ SBCС materials.

However, for current financial year i.e. 2023-24, funds shall be transferred for Activity-1 i.e Kuni Calendar which is to be printed and distributed for three months i.e. for January, February & March, 2024 and Activity-2 i.e. Aama Kuni Pilaa Toy Kit.** ***A. Kuni Calendar:*** This is a calendar with pictorial demonstration of age and development specific stimulating activities facilitating different development components such as psycho-social, physical & motor, language, creative & aesthetic aspects. The Calendar is categorized for three age groups i.e. for less than one year, 1-2 years & 2-3. It shall be distributed each month by the AWW to the concerned parents during Ankur Diwas to ensure timely accessibility. The AWW would sensitise the parents and caregivers so that they can engage with their children and monitor its cognitive and physical development. ***B. Toy Kit:*** Funds for preparing toys at Anganwadi centres shall be released under Aama Kuni Pilaa scheme. DSWOs, shall share the guidelines and funds to CDPOs, who shall then transfer the same to the AWWs to prepare low cost and child friendly toys for under three children, in coordination with parents and community. The AWW would undertake due discussions with Matru Committee/ Jaanch committee/ parents to create awareness amongst them about the scheme and its benefits and also to keep them involved. A copy of the toy catalogue attached at [Annexure-A](https://wcd.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-06/21.%2026179_ECCE-Aama%20Kuni%20Pilaa.pdf.pdf) to this guideline may be referred to while developing the Toy Kit guidelines at District level. Operation modalities and budget break up for toy preparation is attached at [Annexure-B](https://wcd.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2025-06/21.%2026179_ECCE-Aama%20Kuni%20Pilaa.pdf.pdf) for your reference. ***C. Training:*** State level training on Aama Kuni Pilaa shall be organized at HETC, Bhubaneswar wherein all Als, retired officials such as CDPOs/ DSWOs and Freelancers shall be trained. Thereafter, the trained State Level resource personnel shall conduct physical training at district level. District level trainings for the CDPOs, LSs & AWWs shall be organized at AWW and Helper Training Centres of the District.

brief_description: UDID Card or Unique Disability Identity card is an initiative by Government of India with a view of creating a National Database for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). Under the UDID project Disability Certificate and Unique Disability Identity Card is issued to each PwD through online platform.
detailed_description: The “Unique Disability ID (UDID)” has been launched by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Government of India, aiming to create a national database of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) and issue a Unique Disability Identity Card to each individual to ensure transparency, efficiency, and ease in delivering government benefits. Through this scheme, Disability Certificates and Unique Disability Identity Cards are provided to Persons with Disabilities across the country. The scheme is implemented by competent medical authorities notified by the respective State Governments and Union Territories through the centralised UDID portal. The project supports online application submission, assessment of disability percentage by hospitals or Medical Boards, online renewal and updating of information, and integrated management of government schemes and benefits for PwDs. It also eliminates duplicate records and enables tracking of the physical and financial progress of beneficiaries at the village, block, district, state, and national levels. District Welfare Officers assist in registration camps and application management, while District Collectors monitor implementation through reporting features available on the portal. **Objectives:** - To create a national database of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs). - To issue a Unique Disability Identity Card (UDID) to each individual. - To ensure transparency, efficiency, and ease in delivering government benefits to PwDs. - To maintain uniformity across regions in disability certification and identification. - To eliminate duplicate records of Persons with Disabilities. - To enable online renewal and updating of disability-related information. - To support integrated management of government benefits and schemes for PwDs. - To provide nationwide availability of PwD data through a centralized web application.
benefits: The Unique Disability Identity (UDID) card, also known as the Swavlamban Card, is a mandatory document for persons with disabilities (PwDs) in the Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu to access various central and state government welfare schemes. The UDID card ensures a uniform, digitized record that eliminates the need for carrying multiple documents and provides a single, nation-wide proof of disability.
documents_required:
1. Aadhaar Card
2. Passport Size photo
application_process: Online Step 1: Visit the official UDID Portal . Step 2: Click on “Apply For UDID” on the homepage. Step 3: Register as a Person with Disability (PwD) on the portal. Step 4: Log in using the registered credentials. Step 5: Fill in the online application form for the Disability Certificate and UDID card with the required details. Step 6: Upload the required documents, including medical and identity-related documents. Step 7: Submit the application through the portal. Step 8: The concerned Medical Authority/Medical Board verifies the application and conducts disability assessment for the calculation of disability percentage. Step 9: The Medical Authority issues the Disability Certificate and UDID card electronically through the portal upon approval. Step 10: Track the application status using the “Track Your Application” facility available on the portal. Step 11: Download and print the Disability Certificate and UDID card after approval. Step 12: Use the portal for renewal, replacement, or updating of information whenever required. **Step 1:** Visit the official [UDID Portal](https://swavlambancard.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on “Apply For UDID” on the homepage. **Step 3:** Register as a Person with Disability (PwD) on the portal. **Step 4:** Log in using the registered credentials. **Step 5:** Fill in the online application form for the Disability Certificate and UDID card with the required details. **Step 6:** Upload the required documents, including medical and identity-related documents. **Step 7:** Submit the application through the portal. **Step 8:** The concerned Medical Authority/Medical Board verifies the application and conducts disability assessment for the calculation of disability percentage. **Step 9:** The Medical Authority issues the Disability Certificate and UDID card electronically through the portal upon approval. **Step 10:** Track the application status using the “Track Your Application” facility available on the portal. **Step 11:** Download and print the Disability Certificate and UDID card after approval. **Step 12:** Use the portal for renewal, replacement, or updating of information whenever required.

name: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
category: Business & Entrepreneurship, Health & Wellness, Skills & Employment, Social welfare & Empowerment
tags: Medicine, Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Entrepreneur, Janaushadhi, Pharmacist, Incentive
brief_description: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, in November 2008. Under the scheme, dedicated outlets known as Janaushadhi Kendras are opened to make quality generic medicines available to all at affordable prices.
detailed_description: The scheme Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP) was launched by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, in November 2008. Branded medicines are sold at significantly higher prices than their unbranded generic equivalents, though both are identical in therapeutic value. Given the widespread poverty across the country, making reasonably priced quality generic medicines available in the market benefits all sections of society. **Objectives:** To make quality generic medicines available at affordable prices to all, PMBJP was launched by the Government of India in November 2008. Under the scheme, dedicated outlets known as Janaushadhi Kendras are opened to provide generic medicines at affordable prices. As of March 2026, more than 19,000 Kendras are functional across the country. The product basket comprises 2,100 medicines and 300 surgical items. The scheme is implemented by the Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI) [erstwhile BPPI], registered under the Societies Registration Act. **Objectives include:** - Ensuring access to quality medicines for all, especially the poor and deprived. - Creating awareness about generic medicines through education and publicity to counter the perception that quality is linked only to high prices. - Generating employment by engaging entrepreneurs in opening Kendras.
benefits: > **The scheme is operated by government agencies as well as private entrepreneurs.** **1**. **Normal Incentive:** - PMBJKs run by entrepreneurs/Pharmacists/Trusts/Societies & Charitable Organizations linked with PMBI headquarters through PoS software receive incentives. - Incentive @ 20% of monthly purchase from PMBI, subject to a ceiling of Rs. 20,000 per month. - Disbursed on a 50:50 basis: - 10% incentive on purchase (up to Rs. 10,000). - 10% incentive for maintaining stock of 200 medicines (up to Rs. 10,000). **2**. **Special Incentive:** - One-time grant of Rs. 2 lakh for women entrepreneurs, SC/ST, Divyangjan, ex-servicemen, and entrepreneurs in aspirational districts, Himalayan, island, and North-Eastern regions. - ₹1.5 lakh reimbursement for furniture/fixtures. - ₹0.5 lakh reimbursement for computer, internet, printer, etc. **3**. **Affordable Medicines:** - Prices of Janaushadhi medicines are 50%–80% lower than branded medicines. **4.** **Quality Assurance:** - Medicines procured only from WHO-GMP certified suppliers. **5**. **Testing:** - Each batch is tested at NABL-accredited laboratories. **6**. **Margin:** - Operating agencies receive a 20% margin on MRP (excluding taxes) of each drug. > **Janaushadhi Suvidha Sanitary Napkin:** Launched on 27 August 2019, Janaushadhi Suvidha Oxo-biodegradable sanitary napkins are available at Rs. 1 per pad. - Distributed through all Kendras nationwide. - Cumulative sales crossed 100 crore pads by March 2026.
